newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 24 Kurd rebels dead in fighting.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 24 Kurd rebels dead in fighting.

text.p: Turkey said on Tuesday its forces had killed 24 Kurdish guerrillas for the loss of one member of the security forces in fighting in the southeast of the country.
The regional governor's office in the city of Diyarbakir said 15 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels and one soldier died in the province of Bingol on Tuesday.
Nine PKK fighters also died near the town of Savur, the office said. Security officials on Monday reported that the rebels killed a soldier and a policeman in Savur, near the Syrian border.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between government forces and the rebels, fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence in the southeast.
